programmes.programName: Programa oficial de doctorado interuniversitario Matemáticas y Estadística
programmes.evidence: Current 2026–27 official university doctorate catalogue lists Mathematics and Statistics; its official university mathematics institute programme page explicitly labels Estadística e investigación operativa among Líneas de investigación del Programa de Doctorado. This is a named doctoral research area within a broader academic doctorate, not a separately titled degree.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official Faculty of Sciences doctoral-programmes page explicitly includes Mathematics and Statistics and says its doctoral programmes require an original-research thesis and lead to the title Doctor por la Universidad de Zaragoza.

limitations: Joint programme spans La Laguna, Oviedo, Basque Country, Public University of Navarra and Zaragoza; official organisation page names Zaragoza coordinating institution. One shared award route should not be duplicated under each participant without separate campus offering evidence.
Research line is not a diploma annotation; preserve broader doctorate title and named line distinction.

branches.conclusion: 2026–27 central doctorate list and Economy/Management programme detail show no exact Ops/MS/IE business route; other formal business doctoral areas and units remain to review.
Current Mathematics and Statistics doctorate has named Statistics and Operations Research doctoral research line. Other exact technical doctoral areas and units remain to review.

sources.note: Full official 2026–27 university doctoral inventory by knowledge branch; formal titles in Engineering, Sciences and Social Sciences contain no Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering.
Official Mathematics and Statistics PhD labels Statistics and Operations Research explicitly as a research line, not a formal doctoral programme or named specialization.
Full 2026–27 Economy and Management of Organisations doctorate identifies Management and Marketing research areas and Department of Management and Marketing; no named Operations title.

Official doctorate specification describes original research and doctoral thesis for university doctoral qualification, supporting academic research-doctorate credential; page itself is another doctoral programme and used solely for university-level doctorate credential convention.

limitations: Corrects frozen 158 interpretation: contract accepts explicitly programme-named doctoral research areas; formal Statistics and Operations Research line qualifies.
